messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: realtime.edge.eu-west streaming p99 latency > 2s for 6m. p95 trending 300ms -> 650ms. Error rate +0.4% (small). Incident ID: INC-80724. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/edge/80724
oncall-oliver: oncall here, paging SRE. Affected: hosted streaming + websocket ingestion in eu-west?
sre_jamie: taking. quick sanity checks: are kv-cache miss rates up? any recent deploys to edge routing?
incident-bot: recent deploys: none in last 30m. kv-cache miss ratio spiked from 2% -> 18% on rtr-edge-*. Top path: /v1/stream/generate.
infra_raj: I see elevated tail latency on nodes rtr-edge-13/14 with CPU steal and network egress bursts. Could be noisy neighbor on host or NIC queueing.
ml_ops_anya: also seeing large KV-lookup latencies in logs (redis): `latency_ms` percentiles 95/99 = 120ms / 900ms. That lines up with token generation stalls.
oncall-oliver: customers impacted? any logs of streaming disconnects? product_emily: small uptick in reconnects from EU sessions; CS already flagged 3 paying customers experiencing longer responses, not full errors though.
sre_jamie: immediate mitigations: 1) shift traffic off rtr-edge-13/14 to healthy nodes; 2) enable degraded streaming mode (shorter prefetch, flush less) to avoid large KV RTO; 3) roll routing to us fallback if needed. I'll run steps 1+2 now.
infra_raj: route-shift cmd ready. running safe drain for rtr-edge-13: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/v1/nodes/drain -d '{"node":"rtr-edge-13","reason":"latency spike"}'`
ml_ops_anya: toggling degraded streaming: `PATCH /api/v1/stream/config {"prefix_cache":"aggressive","batch_timeout_ms":10}` — doing a quick flag flip to reduce KV pressure.
sre_jamie: applied drain + config flip. Watching p95/p99 on dash.
incident-bot: auto-check: within 45s after actions, p95 for streaming in eu-west down from 650ms -> 220ms; p99 down from 2.4s -> 480ms. TTL: trending stable but still above baseline.
oncall-oliver: good. Can we confirm no customer-facing errors? product_emily: CS reports latency improved for those 3 customers, no new complaints in last 10m. :white_check_mark:
ml_ops_anya: adding a short log query I ran: ```kql
source:edge-logs | where path=="/v1/stream/generate" and region=="eu-west" | stats p95(latency_ms), p99(latency_ms) by node
```
sre_jamie: follow-up: schedule a graceful restart of rtr-edge-13/14 after drain to clear NIC queues and free up memory. infra_raj can you handle that?
infra_raj: yes, will schedule restarts in 5m. also opening a Jira: RDF-9812 to track root cause + host remediation.
oncall-oliver: who owns post-incident customer notification? product_emily: I'll coordinate with CS, short note saying we experienced elevated latency that may have affected streaming responsiveness in EU and that mitigation is applied; we'll follow up with RCA.
sre_jamie: quick checklist for handoff: - p95/p99 graphs link - node drain actions & timestamps - degraded streaming flag change - list of affected customers (CS) - Jira ticket for RCA. I'm going to hand off to infra_raj once restarts are done.
incident-bot: NOTE: paging window: oncall re-evaluate in 30m or earlier if p99 > 1s.
infra_raj: restart done for both nodes, monitoring CPU/NET. p99 holding ~400-500ms, no error surge.
oncall-oliver: thanks team. leaving channel for now, will rejoin if it flares.
product_emily: filed customer note draft and sent to CS for review.
ml_ops_anya: I'll run follow-up evals on kvcache hit patterns and model kv affinity; suspect eviction pressure from a leading traffic shift. Will add mitigation suggestions to RDF-9812.
sre_jamie: closing immediate bridge. next: RCA doc and postmortem penciled for tomorrow 10am PT. tagging infra_raj, ml_ops_anya, product_emily. :spiral_calendar: 
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-80724 -> status: mitigated. p99 back to acceptable window. Actions recorded to RDF-9812.
